images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5 cinematic frame on a Saturn ring expedition platform. An attractive adult Korean Shorthair cheese-tabby cat; natural balanced sturdy build; bright warm orange short coat with realistic darker tabby stripes; clean white fur on muzzle and chin continuing naturally through neck, chest and belly; all four paws clean white from toes upward; a distinctive congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around the mouth resembling a curry stain, explicitly not food or dirt; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. Wearing an original practical high-tech rescue suit without branding, the cat shows enormous open-mouth yawn and is leaning far over a ledge, safely supported by a transparent film rig. Below, a luminous rescue beacon cuts through a simulated orbit-station breach; a tiny matchbox hotel with windows floats in a transparent display case, and a giant projected cat eye appears beyond it. Snow falls over a miniature sandy beach on Saturn's rings, visibly becoming shells instead of melting. Extreme low-angle heroic frame, camera distance four meters, viewpoint from ring-dust level looking upward, 14mm lens, deep focus on cat, ledge, beacon, and Saturn arc, hard rim sunlight with cyan emergency glow, authentic suit materials, dust reflections, realistic paws and whiskers. Safe compositing, miniature scale, no injury or falling. Correct feline anatomy, no duplicate cats, no extra limbs, no human features, no cartoon, illustration, 3D render, plastic fur, logos, text, watermark, UI, captions, or readable title.
